name: release
description: Gates a release on intent, constraints, proof, review, and handoff.

stages.purpose: State what is being released and what success looks like.
Establish the written quality bar with thresholds.
Record the release path chosen, the alternatives it beat, and what would reopen it.
Write the proof that the release meets the constraints.
Adversarial review against the stated constraints.
Leave a takeover-ready record of the release state.

rules: Do not begin a stage until the previous stage's artifact is complete and its evidence block is filled.
A constraint without a threshold and a failure action is not a constraint.
Emit a decision when more than one release path is viable; omit the artifact when only one path survives.
If review finds an unresolved high-severity finding, do not proceed to handoff.
completion: Done when the review artifact is empty of unresolved high-severity findings and the handoff artifact records the release state.
